q: the episode about someone suing the sec

q: the venice ai guy on the dollar collapsing
answer:
Eric Vorhees, the founder of Venice AI, is bullish on Bitcoin and expects the dollar to collapse toward zero. Around 1:20:02 in the episode, he argues that he doesn't see "any world in which dollars become deflationary" because "government prints, government only prints them, they print more and more and more."
